status: Independent second-pass review complete; canonical correction adopted through full registry refresh and strengthened production browser verification passed.
method: Fetched fresh get_design_context with screenshot for all 20 exact family nodes; every fresh PNG was byte-identical to the previously captured original Figma PNG inspected side by side with the production consumer.
Manually viewed all 20 Figma/consumer screenshot pairs and audited nested typography, colors, original glyph slots, spacing, progress geometry, line breaks, clipping and source instance overrides.

Compared the fresh high-fidelity nested source values against current canonical implementations and actual production computed styles. The existing geometry/font gate was treated as baseline evidence, not proof of complete fidelity.

corrections.change: Set text-snapp-text-primary at the ProductivityList ul so interactive and read-only rows share the source color; headings and time totals remain brand #2f455c.
corrections.regression: Both registry and consumer browser gates now require all 8 row strings to be primary and all 4 heading/time strings to remain brand.
corrections.redEvidence: Before source correction and consumer refresh, the strengthened consumer gate failed only the new nested-row color check for all 8 values. All 50 geometry checks, 214 custom-font samples and 17 interactions remained valid.
corrections.greenEvidence: Production consumer on the verified current JS/CSS passed all 50 specimen geometry checks, 214 actual Aptos/Inter font samples, 17 interactions, eight corrected primary row strings and four retained brand heading/time strings. The corrected 338 x 300 ProductivityPanel capture was visually inspected against the original Figma reference.
